name: 甘奈＆千雪
text: お疲れ様です！
trans: Good afternoon!

name: 甜花
text: あぅ……

name: 甘奈
text:
……！
て、甜花ちゃん大丈夫！？
trans:
......!
A-Are you okay, Tenka-chan!?

name: 甜花
text:
足、もう……
動かない……
trans: Tenka... can't...... move her legs anymore......

name: 千雪
text:
レッスン、たくさん頑張ったもんね
ちょっとお休みしてから帰ろうか
trans:
You were probably working really hard at your
lessons. You should head home after taking a break.

name: 甜花
text: うん……
trans: Okay......

name: 甘奈
text:
甘奈、ミルクティー作るね！
お砂糖は入れる？
trans: I'll make some milk tea! Want sugar?

name: 千雪
text:
ありがとう。私は一緒に作るから
大丈夫
trans:
Thank you, I'll make it with you, so don't worry about
me.

name: 甘奈
text:
はーい！
甜花ちゃんは？
trans: You got it! What about you, Tenka-chan?

name: 甜花
text: 甘いの……
trans: Sweet please......

name: 甘奈
text:
わかった！
ちょっとだけ待っててね！
trans: Got it! Wait just a sec!

name: 甘奈
text: 甜花ちゃん、元気出た？
trans: Are you feeling better, Tenka-chan?

name: 甜花
text:
にへへ……
ちょっと、復活……
trans:
Nihehe......
Tenka's... been revived......

name: 千雪
text:
ふたりとも、ちょっといいかな？
お誘いしたいことがあるんだけど
trans:
Do you two have a minute? I'd like to talk about
something.

name: 千雪
text:
以前お世話になった女優さんから
舞台にご招待いただいたんだけど
trans:
I was invited to participate in a play by an
actress that I used to work with.

name: 千雪
text: よかったら、どう？
trans: Would you like to come see?

name: 甘奈
text:
行きたい！
どんなお話！？
trans: I wanna! What kinda story is it!?

name: 千雪
text:
『鶴の恩返しをアレンジした現代コメディ』
なの
trans:
It's a modern comedy based on "The Gratitude of the
Crane".

name: 甘奈
text:
わ！　めっちゃ面白そう！
甜花ちゃんも行かない？
trans:
Ooh! That seems super interesting! Wanna go,
Tenka-chan?

name: 甜花
text:
う、うん……
座って観る、だけなら……
trans:
Y-Yeah......
If all Tenka has to do... is sit and watch......

name: 甘奈
text: やったー☆
trans: Yay☆

name: 千雪
text:
ふふっ
それなら、ふたりの分もお願いしておくね
trans: Fufu, in that case I'll get you two tickets.

name: 甘奈
text: 舞台、めーっちゃ面白かったね！
trans: That play was really funny!

name: 甜花
text:
うん……！
すごく、よかった……！
trans:
Yeah......!
Tenka... really liked it......!

name: 甘奈
text:
千雪さん、改めてだけど
甘奈たちも誘ってくれてありがと！
trans: I know I already said it, but thanks for inviting us!

name: 甜花
text: ありがと……
trans: Thanks......

name: 千雪
text:
うん。どういたしまして
お礼は私からふたりの分も、女優さんに伝えておきます
trans:
Sure. You're very welcome. I'll give your thanks to my
friend as well.

name: 甜花
text:
鶴の恩返し……
あんま、覚えてなかった……けど……
trans:
Tenka... didn't really remember much... about the
particular story...... but.......

name: 甜花
text:
お話、ちゃんと……
楽しかった……！
trans: The story itself was... really funny......!

name: 甘奈
text: ね！
trans: It was!

name: 甘奈
text:
元のお話を覚えてなくても
楽しめるようになってて、すごいなって思った！
trans:
I think it's amazing that they could have people enjoy
it even when they don't remember the original!

name: 千雪
text:
それでいて、覚えている人には
細かいネタで笑えるようにしていたよね
trans:
And yet, the people who do remember the story can
still laugh at all the little details.

name: 甜花
text:
う、うん……
甜花、ちょっとだけなら……覚えてる………！
trans:
Y-Yeah......
Tenka... remembers... a little bit......!

name: 甜花
text: え、えと……

name: 甜花
text:
おじいさんとおばあさんが……
鶴、助けて……
trans: An old man and lady...... rescue... a crane......

name: 千雪
text: うんうん
trans: Yeah that's right.

name: 甜花
text:
雪……降ってるから……
帽子、被せてあげて……
trans: And... it was snowing... so they gave it their hat......

name: 甜花
text:
街のなかで……
手袋も、買う……
trans:
And then they bought...... some golden gloves... for
it......

name: 千雪
text:
ふふっ、それなら
冬でも暖かそう
trans:
Fufu, seems like it could be pretty warm regardless
of the weather.

name: 甘奈
text: なんか、色々と混ざっちゃってる……？
trans: I think you're getting some stuff mixed up...?

name: 甜花
text:
そう、かも……
にへへ……
trans: You might... be right...... Nihehe......

name: 甘奈
text:
……お家に帰ったら
絵本、ちょっと読み返してみよっか……！
trans: ...Let's reread it once we get home...!

name: 甜花
text: うん……

name: 甘奈
text:
余韻がすごいな～
頭の中が舞台と絵本のことでいっぱいで
trans:
It's amazing how we can remember it though～
We have so many plays and stuff in our heads.

name: 甘奈
text:
関係あることが
ぜ～んぶ、気になっちゃう！
trans: I love aaaanything semi-related to them!

name: 千雪
text:
こういう時間って、とっても大切で
いいなって思うなぁ
trans: I think spending time like this is very important.

name: 甜花
text:
うん……
みんな一緒に、夢中になるの……
trans:
Yeah......
It's kinda fun......

name: 甜花
text:
なんか……
楽しい、ね……
trans: Getting so... immersed together......

name: 甘奈
text: ねー☆
trans: Right?☆
